items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had Ron Jefferson and Leroy Vinnegar.

ctx.x: Funky piano. Not anybody you mentioned already? Not Sonny Clark or . . . .
No, real big. Short, heavy. He had Ron Jefferson and Leroy Vinnegar.
I’m thinking Buckner, but he was an organist, Milt Buckner. You said short and heavy.
